greeting: Mostly open after a short review with Mike. The girls go back to Jen this evening and you fly to Toronto tomorrow for ICGN, so the quiet afternoon is the natural window for panel prep and packing.

needsAttention.title: Moderate Plenary 7 at ICGN Thursday
needsAttention.detail: You fly to Toronto tomorrow and moderate the stewardship-data panel Thursday at 3:05 PM with Gupta, Ambachtsheer and Howard. Today's open afternoon is the window to shape your framing and opening questions.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: A p1 in Dan & Mike Stuff, overdue since mid-September: a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the thinnest rental in that market and only gets harder to find.

needsAttention.title: December break not yet chosen
needsAttention.detail: Travel for six over three weeks — the Sept 30 decision and Oct 15 booking dates have both passed, and holiday inventory thins the longer it sits.

acts.line: A 15-minute review with Mike at nine, then the morning opens up with the girls around.
Wide open — the first real stretch of quiet in a while, a trip to Toronto waiting tomorrow.
The house settles toward a quiet night before you head north.
